manga.label: Manga cel
manga.summary: The default comic finish: flat two-dimensional Japanese-comic shading with even linework. Use it for every panel of one comic so all panels look like they came from the same hand.

contract.line: crisp even-weight black to near-black navy contours, closed and confident, no sketchy or coloured linework, no painterly edges
contract.shading: flat cel shading in two hard steps with hard shadow edges, ambient occlusion only as a distinct tercel under drapery; absolutely no gradient, airbrush, rim-light bloom or volumetric light
contract.highlights: small hard-edged highlights on hair and eyes only, plus one crisp specular on metal trim
contract.palette: bright saturated anime hues over a warm neutral base; every character keeps her own hue family, all held inside one shared saturation and contrast level
contract.finish: flat two-dimensional animation cel artwork, matte surface, no photographic depth of field, no 3D render pass, no texture overlay. The picture must read as a drawn comic page, not as a rendered illustration or a photo

notes: Keep every panel of one comic on exactly this line weight, shading step count and contrast level. A panel that switches to rendered lighting breaks the set even when the drawing itself is correct.
Do not copy Whale-chan's face, hair, whale-fin ears, ahoge or maid outfit onto another character.
The style preset fixes line, shading and finish; identity always comes from each character's own sheet.

house.label: House whale line
house.summary: The style the bundled Whale-chan references are drawn in. Use it when the cast must sit next to existing Whale-chan art without a visible seam.

contract.line: bold near-black navy contours of even weight, closed shapes, no sketchy or coloured linework
contract.shading: restrained soft cel shading in two clean steps, shadows following the form, never gradient airbrush
contract.highlights: sparse glossy highlights only on hair, eyes and metal trim
contract.palette: deep navy, ocean blue, cyan, white, warm pale skin, muted gold; each character keeps her own hue family inside that saturation range
contract.finish: clean flat-coloured anime illustration with crisp edges, no texture overlay, no 3D render pass

notes: Do not copy Whale-chan's face, hair, whale-fin ears, ahoge or maid outfit onto another character.
The style preset fixes line, shading and finish; identity always comes from each character's own sheet.

clean-anime.label: Clean anime
clean-anime.summary: Neutral modern TV-anime finish. Use when the picture is not meant to match existing Whale-chan art.

contract.line: crisp dark-brown to black linework of even weight with clean corners
contract.shading: single-step cel shading with soft ambient occlusion under drapery
contract.highlights: small sharp highlights on hair and eyes
contract.palette: bright saturated hues over a warm neutral base, consistent across the cast
contract.finish: flat anime illustration with readable silhouettes and no painterly blending

notes: Keep every character on the same line weight and shading step count.
Do not add per-character rendering tricks; the style contract is shared.

soft-cel.label: Soft cel
soft-cel.summary: Gentler pastel cel finish with slightly heavier rim light, for calm or emotional pictures.

contract.line: thin dark-grey linework, softened at the extremities
contract.shading: soft cel shading blended at the shadow edge with a light rim on every figure
contract.highlights: diffuse highlight bands across hair and fabric folds
contract.palette: muted pastels with one accent hue per character, kept at the same saturation
contract.finish: soft-edged flat illustration, no photographic texture

notes: Apply identical rim light and shadow softness to every character in frame.
Avoid value clash between characters; hold one contrast level for the whole image.
